zh: 刚才我看到地上有水，提醒你小心滑倒。
old_en: Just now I saw water on the floor, so I reminded you to look out for slipping.
new_en: I saw water on the floor earlier and wanted to remind you to look out for slipping.

zh: 昨天在楼梯口，我提醒你小心台阶。
old_en: Yesterday at the stairwell, I reminded you to look out for the steps.
new_en: Yesterday at the stairs, I reminded you to look out for the steps.

zh: 过马路的时候，请提醒我小心车辆。
old_en: When crossing the road, please remind me to look out for the cars.
new_en: When crossing the road, please remind me to look out for cars.

zh: 明天去公园，记得提醒我小心路上的石头。
old_en: When we go to the park tomorrow, remind me to look out for stones on the path.
new_en: When we go to the park tomorrow, remind me to look out for stones on the path.
